overview.description: 7 Card Stud Hi-Lo: seven cards each (two down, four up, one down). Pot split between best high hand and best qualifying low (typically 8-or-better). Can scoop with best of both. USA.

history.origins: 7 Card Stud split-pot variant; pot divided between best high hand and best qualifying low (typically 8-or-better). USA; popular in home and casino mixed games.
timeline: Present: Common in HORSE and mixed games

rules.objective: Win the high half and/or the low half of the pot; best high hand and best qualifying low (e.g. 8-or-better) split; one player can scoop both.
rules.gameplay: Same as 7 Card Stud (two down, four up, one down; betting rounds). At showdown, best high hand and best qualifying low split the pot. Ace can count high or low for low.

strategy.basic: Play for both ways when possible; qualify low (8-or-better).
strategy.intermediate: Read board for scoop potential; fold weak one-way hands.
strategy.advanced: Third street decisions; when to chase low or high only.
tips: Pot split high and low; qualify for low (e.g. 8-or-better).

list.name: Seven Card Stud Hi-Lo Eight or Better
list.description: High-low split pot with an 8-or-better qualifier for low using ace-to-five lowball ranking; if no qualifying low hand, the high hand wins the entire pot.
list.emptyOverridesReason: This variant only tightens the low-hand qualifier and ranking rules; engine overrides for these parameters are not yet modeled.

list.name: Seven Card Stud High-Low with Declare
list.description: After the final betting round, players simultaneously declare high, low, or both (for example using chips in hand); only declared directions may win their half of the pot, and a both-declaring player must win both high and low to scoop.
list.emptyOverridesReason: This home-game variant adds a declaration step before showdown; engine overrides and UI for declaration sequencing are not yet modeled.

phases.label: Ante
phases.notes: All players post the ante; then dealer deals two down, one up (third street).

phases.label: Third Street
phases.notes: Betting round after 2 down, 1 up; bring-in or high hand may start.

phases.label: Fourth Street
phases.notes: Each player receives one card face up; then betting.

phases.label: Fifth Street
phases.notes: Fifth card face up; then betting.

phases.label: Sixth Street
phases.notes: Sixth card face up; then betting.

phases.label: Seventh Street
phases.notes: Seventh card face down; final betting round.

phases.label: Declare
phases.notes: Players declare high, low, or both (e.g. chips in fist); simultaneous reveal.

phases.label: Showdown
phases.notes: Reveal seven cards; best five high and best five low (if qualifying) determine winners.

phases.label: Award Pot
phases.notes: Pot split between high and low; odd chip to high; scoop if one wins both.

ante.description: Post the required ante into the pot before any cards are dealt.
ante.constraints: Mandatory at start of hand; amount agreed (e.g. small fraction of small bet).

deal.reason: Deal is performed by the dealer; not a player action.

reveal_market.reason: This game does not use a market to reveal.

buy_market.reason: This game has no market purchase.

buy_stock.reason: This game has no buying from stock.

fold.description: Forfeit the hand and drop out of the current pot; no further action in the hand.
fold.constraints: Legal during any betting round when it is your turn to act.

check.description: Decline to bet when no bet has been made in the current round; stay in the hand.
check.constraints: Legal only when no player has bet in the current betting round.

call.description: Match the current bet to stay in the hand.
call.constraints: Legal when at least one player has bet in the current round and you have not yet matched.

bet.description: Place a bet (small or big bet per street rules); opens or reopens the betting.
bet.constraints: Legal when no bet has been made this round, or when completing from bring-in; amount depends on street and limit.

raise.description: Increase the current bet; subsequent players must call the new amount or fold.
raise.constraints: Legal when a bet has been made; maximum three raises per round; raise size small or big per street.

declare.description: Declare high, low, or both (e.g. chips in fist: 1 high, 0 low, 2 both); revealed simultaneously.
declare.constraints: After seventh street betting; required before showdown when playing with declaration.

reveal_hand.description: Show all seven cards; best five for high and best five for low (if qualifying) determine winners.
reveal_hand.constraints: At showdown; cards speak for themselves; may compete for both halves.

award_pot.description: Pot split between best high hand and best qualifying low; odd chip to high; scoop if one wins both.
award_pot.constraints: After showdown; with 8-or-better, no qualifying low means high wins entire pot.

play_card.reason: 7 Card Stud is a deal-and-bet game; players do not play cards to a trick, they bet and reveal at showdown.

draw.reason: This game has no draw-from-stock action.

discard.reason: This game has no discard pile.

pass.reason: This game has no pass action.

bid.reason: This game has no bid action.

meld.reason: This game has no meld action.

go_out.reason: This game has no go-out action.

engine.deckDescription: A standard 52-card French deck comprising four suits: Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, and Spades. Each suit contains thirteen ranks: Ace, 2 through 10, Jack, Queen, and King, providing versatile options for various card games.
engine.suitDescription: Suits and ranks are as defined in the deck description above; no separate suit or rank set is used for this game.
engine.rankDescription: Suits and ranks are as defined in the deck description above; no separate suit or rank set is used for this game.
engine.dealPattern: 2 down, 1 up (third street), then 1 up each for fourth, fifth, sixth street, then 1 down (seventh street); clockwise.
